entities.name: Ravus
entities.description: Aggressive Elder Dragon hatched in the second egg-fall of the Ur-Dragon, killed in the Elder Dragon War.

entities.name: Rubra
entities.description: Elder Dragon, sibling of Ravus, hit in the eye by a poisoned bolt.

entities.name: Lividus
entities.description: Elder Dragon, sibling of Ravus who tracked Bolas's army with him.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon whose human army challenged Ravus and his brothers; planeswalker.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: Dragon on Dominaria who laid the egg-falls of the Elder Dragons.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: War between the Elder Dragons in which Ravus died.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where the Elder Dragons hatched.

events.summary: Ravus is hatched in the second egg-fall of the Ur-Dragon during the Birth of the Elder Dragons.
events.quote: Ravus was hatched during the Birth of the Elder Dragons , in the second egg-fall by the Ur-Dragon on Dominaria .

events.summary: Ravus and his brothers defeat the human army of Nicol Bolas, though Rubra is hit by a poisoned bolt.
events.quote: Ravus and his brothers were challenged by the human army of Nicol Bolas .

events.summary: Bolas's sorcerers disintegrate Ravus with a spell in a canyon.
events.quote: a squadron of sorcerers flung a disintegration spell at Ravus.

relations.quote: his siblings Vaevictis Asmadi , Rubra , and Lividus

relations.note: Bolas's army challenged Ravus and his brothers.
relations.quote: Ravus and his brothers were challenged by the human army of Nicol Bolas .
